SEARCH
Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search

Class SearchQuery

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search.SearchQuery
public final class SearchQuery extends Object
An immutable description of one advanced file-system search: where to look (the roots), how names are matched (substring / glob / regex, case sensitivity), whether file contents are grepped too, and the type / size / recency filters that further narrow the result set.

Instances are created through builder(); every field has a sane default (the user's home folder, case-insensitive substring name match, no content search, no size or date bounds, a 5000 result cap) so SearchQuery.builder().build() is a valid "everything under home" query. Being immutable and side-effect free, a query is safe to build on the EDT, hand to a background SearchEngine, and reuse.
